in_marathi.name: Jaydev
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaydev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaydev is a Sanskrit name, derived from Jaya (victory) and Deva (god). This name signifies a victorious god or a god who brings victory. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often referred to as Jaydev, as he was known to bring victory and success to his devotees.
